title: Saddle me Naturalist
description: this mod is an addon for nautralist that adds saddles to, boar, deer, lion, giraffe, hippo, rhino, and elephants.
body:
# Saddle Me: Naturalist

Ever chased a Naturalist deer through the forest and thought *"I should be riding that"*? Now you can. **Saddle Up: Naturalist** turns the wildlife from [Naturalist](https://modrinth.com/mod/naturalist) into proper mounts - each tamed its own way, each with its own riding feel.

## The Stable

| Animal | How to tame | How it rides |
|---|---|---|
| **Deer** | Sneak up feed it an apple and saddle it - the saddler becomes its owner | Fast and nimble, with a charged **leap** on the jump key |
| **Boar** | No taming - just saddle it | Pig-style: steer with a **carrot on a stick**, right-click to boost |
| **Lion** | Raw meat or fish (they're big cats - cod and salmon work) | Fast, with a powerful pounce |
| **Hippo** | **Melon slices** | Swims with you aboard - but only ferries you through shallower water |
| **Rhino** | **Wheat** | Camel-style, with a devastating **charge dash** |
| **Elephant** | **Hay blocks** (or wheat, if you're patient) | Slow, mighty, steps up 1.5 blocks - and hauls **two chests** (30 slots, visibly strapped to its flanks) |

## Lion Prides

Tame the **maned pride leader** and the whole pride half-tames with it: they'll let players ride along, they'll never hurt your owner, and they still follow their leader. Fully tame a follower and it leaves the pride to be yours alone. Keep a leader and three tamed followers near your bed, and the pride **hunts while you sleep** - wake up every ~3-4 days to a gift of meat... or occasionally a bone or a toy. If the leader dies without a tamed heir, the pride abandons you.

## How it works

- **Visible saddles** on every mount, painted onto the animated models
- **Horse-style inventory** - press your inventory key while riding (or sneak + right-click): saddle slot, elephant cargo, the works
- **Owners are sacred** - tamed animals never attack whoever tamed them, but keep their natural tempers with everyone else. Elephants still defend their calves; boars still hold grudges
- **Wild stays wild** - untamed animals keep 100% of their natural behavior. Deer still bolt (sneak up on them), hippos still hate swimmers, rhinos still charge
- Jump-bar **leaps** for deer and lions, camel-style **dashes** for the heavyweights
- Saddles drop on death; shears remove saddles and chests; tamed animals never despawn
- No mining slowdown while mounted

## Compatibility

- Requires **Fabric API** and **Naturalist 5.0pre3** (Fabric, 1.20.1) - GeckoLib comes along with Naturalist
- **[Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade)** (optional): look at any mount to see its owner, speed, and jump height - same format as horses
- Plays nice with **HorseBuff**, lassos, and pick-up mods (zebras aren't touched - base Naturalist already makes them rideable horses)
- Install on **both client and server** - No new items or world gen - safe to add to existing worlds

---

*Built for the NeoCraft SMP. Feedback and bug reports welcome!
